CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RONGON MUKHOPADHYAY HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR RAI ---------
For the Appellant : In person For the Respondent : In person ---------
10/07.03.2025
Pursuant to the order dated 05.02.2025, the appellant-Santosh Kumar Jha, and the respondent-Sarita Jha are physically present before us.
2. At the outset, the appellant has expressed his desire to keep the respondent with him with full dignity and honour.

3. He, however, has stated that the respondent while staying with him should not resort to her earlier behavior with him as well as his relatives which was one of the reasons for him to have filed the suit for dissolution of marriage.

4. He has also stated that the criminal case filed by the respondent against him and others under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and any other cases instituted against the appellant by the respondent should be withdrawn and efforts should be taken by the respondent in ensuring that the criminal case comes to its logical conclusion based on the inclination of the appellant to settle the issue.
5.

The respondent Sarita Jha has readily agreed to the proposal of the appellant to withdraw the criminal case instituted against the appellant and others by her and has also given oral undertaking before us that she will give full dignity and honour to the appellant and her in-laws and has further assured us that no impediment will come from her behalf to disrupt the marital life which she and the appellant both have expressed to restart.

sentences.text:
Since the appellant and the respondent have stated in very clear terms about their intention to stay together and resume their marital life on certain terms and conditions as we have enumerated above, it is directed that these terms and conditions should be put in writing by way of a joint compromise petition signed by both the parties and filed through an affidavit and after such affidavit is filed, the appellant has stated before us that he will withdraw the appeal.
7.

Since the matter appears to have been settled on account of what has been submitted by the appellant and respondent, we adjourn this matter to be listed on 20th March, 2025 under the same heading by which time it is expected that the joint compromise petition as enumerated above shall be filed.
The physical appearance of the appellant and the respondent are dispensed with for the present.
10. Let a copy of this order be handed over to the learned counsel for the respective parties.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J.) (Arun Kumar Rai, J.) Umesh-Abhishek/-
